rows.declining-leaves-the-hand-creature-in-ha: The face-up trigger 'you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield' is optional (CR 603.2c), but the choose the engine poses offers only the single hand_move option [Grizzly Bears] with no decline answer, so 'no' is not a legal answer and the player is forced to put the card onto the battlefield. Observed: answer "no" rejected, only [0 hand_move "Grizzly Bears"] offered; expected a decline option alongside the card pick.
